title: v1_95 / Thank you
content: ## Thank you Last but certainly not least, a big _**Thank You**_ to the contributors of VS Code. ### Issue tracking Contributions to our issue tracking: * [@gjsjohnmurray (John Murray)](https://github.com/gjsjohnmurray) * [@IllusionMH (Andrii Dieiev)](https://github.com/IllusionMH) * [@RedCMD (RedCMD)](https://github.com/RedCMD) ### Pull requests Contributions to `vscode`: *
